subject: Next steps — HealthSync security questionnaire & log export confirmation

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Follow-up from today's call — logs, SOC 2, and questionnaire

Hi Emma / HealthSync security team,

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- What we covered: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire, and audit logging/export requirements (admin activity, API logs, retention/immutability).
- HealthSync asks: a) confirmation that admin and API audit logs are exportable for forensic review, b) immutability/append-only guarantees for retained logs, c) where logs can be pulled (API, SIEM-forwarding, S3 export), and d) SOC 2 report availability and scope.

Action items I captured:
1) Emma: share the vendor security questionnaire (we discussed an XLSX) — you mentioned you'll send it by EOD.
2) Redwood (Aditya): provide a brief package with our SOC 2 status, sample audit-log export, and a short note on immutability and retention controls.
3) Marissa: loop in engineering/security for any technical clarifications and prepare a sample logs export if requested.

For transparency, I'm attaching a short security pack that outlines our controls (redwood_security_pack_v2.pdf). It includes the SOC 2 status page and an outline of our logging capabilities.

Proposed timeline: we can aim to return the completed questionnaire + sample logs within 3 business days once we have the questionnaire. If you need a quicker turnaround for any specific items, let me know which ones are highest priority.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,

Attached is our vendor security questionnaire (HealthSync_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). A couple of clarifications from our side:
- The procurement team needs explicit confirmation on whether log exports include full request/response traces (headers + metadata) or are limited to event-type summaries.
- For HIPAA: if a workload will be used with PHI, we need to confirm BAAs and that export paths do not expose PHI to third-party storage unless encrypted with customer-managed keys.

If you can populate the spreadsheet and return it, we will triage internally and may follow up with a short technical session with our infra/security engineers.

We'd prefer the completed questionnaire back by Thu, Oct 15. If that's tight, let us know which rows you need more time on.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync questionnaire — SOC2 and sample logs (drafts attached)

Adi / Marissa,

I've attached two items: a redacted SOC 2 cover summary we can share under NDA and a small sample export (activity-logs-export-sample.json) that models the output HealthSync asked about. Notes below: 

- SOC 2: latest Type II report completed July 2026. Scope covers system access controls, logging/monitoring, and change management. Full report requires NDA/executive approval; the attached summary is safe for initial review.
- Logs export: the sample includes admin events and API request metadata (timestamp, user_id, action, request_id, resource, outcome). We do not include sensitive request payloads by default; full request/response bodies are only included in exports when a customer opts in and the workspace is configured to persist payloads. That opt-in requires explicit configuration tied to customer-managed encryption keys per our privacy policy.
- Immutability: our export pipeline writes logs to an append-only object store with object versioning enabled and cryptographic checksums. We can provide S3-compatible exports or stream to a SIEM. For HIPAA workflows we recommend the BAA path and CMK encryption on export buckets.

Attachments: redwood_security_pack_v2.pdf (previously sent), activity-logs-export-sample.json, SOC2-shareable-summary.pdf

I'll bake the two-sentence summary for the questionnaire here so Aditya can paste it into the spreadsheet: 
"Redwood's audit logging pipeline captures admin and API events; exports can include full request metadata and optional payloads when customers explicitly enable payload retention and use customer-managed keys. Logs are persisted to an append-only, versioned object store with cryptographic checksums to support immutability guarantees and forensic exports."

If you'd like, I can also prepare a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough with HealthSync's infra team later this week to walk the sample export and encryption options.

—Neha Kapoor
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: activity-logs-export-sample.json, SOC2-shareable-summary.pdf
